title: All-company coverage and end-to-end acceptance

files.change: Per-company/product/phase/track evidence and missing-source dependencies; generated from DB.
Benchmark/run IDs, failures and exact artifacts; never manual green booleans.
Keep only truly unfinished items and unresolved dependencies.

steps: Initial pilots are calibration, not scope reduction. Research all current companies; enumerate all user-requested tracks for chosen supported episodes.

Ready story requires dated, cited situation/action/outcome-or-explicit-unknown; target at least6 reviewed actions across3 relevant tracks for initial pilots, but never invent actions to meet quota. Incomplete story stays partial.
For each requested founder scenario, provide reviewed relevant case or precise missing coverage; do not call goal complete while critical supported scenarios remain empty.
A newly added private company must traverse identity/source/extraction/review/story with no code edits.
Record inaccessible/private/licensing-dependent history distinctly from extraction defects; resolve or explicitly obtain user acceptance of limitation before full-goal completion.
tests: All P00 positive and negative cases; manual factual review of stories and references.
Same input/corpus gives stable selection; corpus update changes only affected stories.
Reject fake exact dates, uncited claims, unsupported causal links and one-case pattern labels.
